sources.topic: Variable file forms, recursive variable selection, overwrite behavior and DRAM-to-flash save intent

contract.data: Owned declared globals and ordinary explicit roots, concrete nominal schemas, partial/unknown data and logical queues; imports/FILE/PATH excluded
contract.restoration: Exact schema, retain unlisted values, create missing roots with validated creation intent, preserve aggregate identities and disconnect queue buffer association
contract.clear: Reset values while retaining declarations, explicit bindings, metadata and aliases; no code unload or native allocation deletion
contract.guards: Full batch preflight, root/status overlap, exact ordinary reference storage, descendant binding identity, foreign active task aliases, connected timers and explicit active/protected flags
contract.effects: Possible VR write effects propagate through routines and condition handlers; proven TP literals/selectors retain existing FOR behavior
contract.recursion: Explicit graph archived per namespace and traversed cycle-safely; every dependency checked before variable/graph changes
contract.dram: Bounded persistent detached flash snapshots, guarded explicit host restore, no automatic power-up hook or native memory placement
contract.files: Shared exact memory/device archive preflight with quota, free-space hint and retained-garbage behavior

boundaries: No native PC/VR/IO bytes, mixed TP/VR PBR_ALLTYPE batch, code unloading or native variable deletion
No live resources/import discovery, automatic DRAM/flash allocation or POWERUP restoration
In-memory preflight without crash/concurrency guarantees; strict mode and controller parity deferred
